newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific gets 89 pct of unit notes.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific gets 89 pct of unit notes.

text.p: Union Pacific Corp said Thursday 89 percent of the outstanding principal amount of Southern Pacific Rail Corp's 9-3/8 percent Senior Notes due 2005 were tendered in response to the company's offer which expired Wednesday.
Southern Pacific is a Union Pacific unit.
Union Pacific said it has accepted for payment and will purchase all notes validly tendered. It said notes totaling about $332 million in principal amount were tendered.
Union Pacific said it will pay for the notes accepted pursuant to the offer on October 7.
